show.description: A humble street vendor’s life turns into a nightmare when powerful enemies humiliate him, threaten his mother, and tear apart his love. But unknown to all, he carries a hidden identity that could shake the entire power structure. As injustice rises, his transformation from helpless to unstoppable begins.
